subject: world_language
concept: Talking about hobbies and free-time activities in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'talk about interests' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student mimes a hobby while saying its name in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a hobby word to its picture
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says a sentence about a hobby they enjoy in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses similar hobby-related verbs in the target language

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
